evidence: Scanning electron microscopy inspection revealed that the conformality of the deposited Pt films was 100% in trenches with aspect ratio (AR) up to 34. Furthermore, transmission electron microscopy (TEM) was used to determine a high-resolution thickness profile of a typical trench with an AR of 22, giving detailed statistical information on the conformality. Spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) measurements performed on a simultaneously coated planar SiO2 substrate showed a Pt film thickness of 33± 1 nm. Cross-section Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) images were used to characterize the films deposited in each of the trenches of interest. A cross-sectional Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) sample was made from the cleaved sample described above, using a standard FIB lift-out procedure. Spectroscopic ellipsometry (SE) measurements were used to determine the thickness of the deposited Pt films.
